name: Daisue Construction Co., Ltd.
summary: Daisue Construction Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the construction business in Japan. The company constructs offices, logistics warehouses, factories, medical facilities, and buildings for weddings and funerals. It is also involved in condominium and refurbishment businesses. In addition, the company provides technologies and solutions, such as structural technology, construction technology, anti-earthquake technology, environmentally friendly technology, and quality technology. Further, it is involved in the insurance agency, nursing home, and labor dispatch businesses. Daisue Construction Co., Ltd. was founded in 1937 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.
